    Listen

    KUTR needed a home that shows how the studio thinks: quiet greys, one sharp accent, and small moments of play for people who look closely.

    The site is a single hand-written page: HTML, CSS and plain JavaScript, with canvas drawing for the globe, the halftone portrait and the motion streaks.

      Sehre Innovative Company
      
    
      Brand identity · 2022
      
    
      
    
      
      The brand
      
      
        
      A bilingual identity for Sehre Innovative Company (ایده‌پردازان هوشمند سهره), a technology company.
      
        
      A round, bird-like symbol sits next to a Persian wordmark built on the same grid, in a palette of deep cherry red, warm whites and near-black.

      YAD Studio
      
    
      Visual identity for a yoga studio
      
    
      
    
      
      The idea
      
      
        
      The logo is inspired by the letter Y, a leaf motif and the bound angle yoga pose.
      
        
      Three overlapping circles give the mark its curves, so the same shape reads as a letter, a growing leaf and a body at rest.
      
      
      
    
      
    
    
      
      
      
    
      
    
      
      Pattern
      
      The arcs of the mark repeat into a pattern that carries the identity onto merchandise and activewear.

      KUTR Studio Branding
      
    
      Visual branding · 2025
      
    
      
    
      
      About KUTR Studio
      
      
        
      Discover KUTR, a design studio built around simplicity, clarity, and human connection. Why a pigeon? Because just like a small messenger, it brings bits of content and meaning to its audience, piece by piece.
      
        
      At its core, KUTR focuses on UX and human interaction, translating ideas into experiences that feel natural and purposeful. Every detail of the identity reflects this vision: approachable, dynamic, and rooted in thoughtful design.
